name: Eshmun
source:
A traditional logic engine created by Hamilcar of Kane. He is part of a two-part system with Sekhmet, building models of potential human dysfunction using a vast pool of recorded data, which is then passed on to Sekhmet for assessment and analysis.

[Edited from [url=https://www.royalroad.com/fiction/28806/the-flower-that-bloomed-nowhere/chapter/590572/028-in-fading-image]The Flower That Bloomed Nowhere Chapter 28[/url]]
